concept: llama.cpp gemma4uv projector type support and first supporting build
summary: `PROJECTOR_TYPE_GEMMA4V`, `GEMMA4A`, `GEMMA4UV` and `GEMMA4UA` are mapped to the strings `gemma4v`, `gemma4a`, `gemma4uv` and `gemma4ua`.

facts.text: `PROJECTOR_TYPE_GEMMA4V`, `GEMMA4A`, `GEMMA4UV` and `GEMMA4UA` are mapped to the strings `gemma4v`, `gemma4a`, `gemma4uv` and `gemma4ua`.
Issue 24251 (opened 2026-06-06) reports a `gemma4uv` mmproj with 11 tensors, vision plus audio encoder, used with master commit 6b80c74f285390368b3c99c5e750f19e9b096e98 (2026-06-07).
Issue 24251 reports NaN logits and a sampler assertion failure with the GPU backend enabled on an RTX 5070 Ti with CUDA 13.0, and was closed as not planned.
Issue 24146 (opened 2026-06-04, build b9518) reports Gemma 4 12B image input returning repeated `<unused49>` tokens or empty output with the ggml-org mmproj on Windows and CUDA.
Issue 24146 diagnoses two causes: the resize never fills the soft-token budget (a 512x512 image became 528x528, 121 tokens, unlike the reference `Gemma4UnifiedImageProcessor`) and an F16 overflow.
A fork commit titled "Fix Gemma 4 12B vision: wrong patch count + F16 overflow (issue #24146)" is linked from issue 24146, and a commenter reported clean results after applying it.
PR 26488 ("mtmd: rebase Gemma 4 unified-vision fixes onto master") was a draft closed on 2026-08-03.
PR 27594 (ngxson, merged 2026-08-23) removes all non-pillow resize variants and corrects `resize_algo` for every model's config.
PR 28335 makes E2B and E4B always use causal attention, keeps global layers causal to match transformers, and fixes the vision token budget, superseding PR 24014.

PR 28335's model table lists gemma-4-12B-it as `use_bidirectional_attention: "vision"`, hidden size 3840, no PLE, "unified (encoder-free)"; 26B-A4B (hidden 2816) and 31B (hidden 5376) are also bidirectional; E2B (1536) and E4B (2560) are causal.
PR 28335 lists a 4-layer MTP drafter "gemma-4-31B-it-assistant" with width 1024 projecting from the 31B backbone (5376).
PR 28751 removes `sched_need_reserve = true` from `llama_context::set_causal_attn()` because the flag only changes KQ mask values, and fixes the `qwen4exp` graph that depended on it.
PR 28751 says the causal flag is flipped twice around each non-causal image chunk for Gemma 3, Gemma 4 and DeepSeek-V4, costing two scheduler reserves per image.
PR 28751's measured speedups on gemma-4-26B-A4B Q4_0 with a BF16 mmproj range from 1.27x (one image, H200) to 7.61x (24 images, `-c 32768 -ub 2048`, RTX 4090); no Apple silicon numbers are given.
The pull-request search for `gemma4uv` lists PR 28919 open (2026-09-15), PR 28751 merged, PR 28335 merged, PR 27594 merged, PR 26488 closed, and PR 23398 (Gemma4 MTP) merged 2026-06-07.
The issue search for `gemma4uv` lists issue 26981 (CUDA SIGABRT in `mtmd_helper_decode_image_chunk`, closed 2026-09-26) and issue 29686 (closed 2026-09-30).
Ollama's 2026-06-04 bump to b9509 states it carries the upstream Gemma 4 12B projector fixes for the `n_head=0` crash (issues 16479 and 16489).
Ollama's compat clip allowlist names `gemma4` but not a separate unified entry.
Upper bound: the first llama.cpp build to recognise `gemma4uv` is at or before b9509 (2026-06-04); the exact first PR was not found.
Every Ollama release pinning b10760 or later recognises `gemma4uv` because the pins are far above b9509.
